title: When Is Heterogeneous Distance-Decay Facility Location Tractable? A Structural Classification, Exact Methods, and a Real-World Study
summary: We study continuous planar facility location in which a demand point's captured value decays with distance, with the per-point decay scale varying across points. This heterogeneity is ubiquitous yet underexploited, and one nearest-facility objective unifies decay, clustering, and median goals, containing k-means, the Weber/p-median problem, and maximum covering as special cases. We make four contributions.
